transcript: This is what happens when you manifest a lot of abundance and your life changes but your nervous system doesn't. This is Jules LeBron. You know that little bit of time where everybody and their mother was saying, very demure, very mindful. Well, it's because of her. Very demure, very mindful. He's even publicly talked about how she started being offered $45,000 to $80,000 for just one single brand video. How it wasn't, oh we'll give you $2,000 for a video, it was $45,000 for a video. $85,000 for a video. Fast forward to now and you'll find out that Jules recently started and ended a GoFundMe asking her followers for $45,000 to fix her teeth. Why are you begging? Because I'm poor. What the fuck are you talking about? So naturally, the internet started asking, where the fuck did all that money go? Jules' story is a perfect and extreme example of something that we don't talk about enough. Get into your next chapter and having the capacity to actually stay there are two completely different things. See, your nervous system likes predictability because predictability equals safety and the unknown equals danger. You can consciously want more money, visibility, love, success, but when you suddenly receive more than you've ever had the capacity to hold before, that amount of change could be incredibly dysregulating to your nervous system, which means more than likely you'll find yourself returning to what was once familiar. Okay, the timeline you just graduated from. Go back to the old habits, the old patterns, the old belief systems, which is why nervous system regulation is not just about being calm or getting grounded. It's about slowly expanding your capacity to experience more, feel more, be seen more, receive more without immediately retracting back to what your nervous system already knows. The point of manifesting or quantum leaping, whatever buzzword you want to throw in there is not to reinvent your life overnight. It's to make small choices that teach your nervous system that the life you're moving toward is not only safe to enter, but also stay in so that you don't end up watching your dreams and everything you just manifested flip right through your little fingers. So what was for your nervous system to rewrite the script and stop thinking that this timeline you're trying to exit is normal and instead feeling that this new timeline you're trying to enter is what's normal because what's normal is safe. And when it's safe, we have an easier time holding it and staying there. Building that capacity is as simple as trying something new, being around new people, resting differently, simply just allowing yourself to receive. You're in Los Angeles or Southern California area. I'd love to invite you to my new flip season inspired sound bath ceremony this Sunday, August 16th. Creating a space to slow down, receive and give your system an idea of what a new normal can feel like because the more your body learns how to feel safe in the magic, the more capacity you have to actually hold it. For information into RSVP, just click on my page. We'll see you there. Love you.
title: Why You Can't Hold the Life You Manifest
one_liner: Your nervous system sabotages success by reverting to familiar patterns when life changes faster than it can adapt.
key_points: A dysregulated nervous system pulls you back to old habits even after achieving external success
Nervous system regulation is about expanding capacity to receive more, not just staying calm
Small, repeated new experiences teach your nervous system that an upgraded life is safe
Jools LeBron's viral-to-broke arc illustrates what happens when abundance outpaces inner capacity
